product-analyst.description: Extract product-model identity/personas/value-prop/capabilities from ingest packs.

workflow-analyzer.description: Extract ordered workflow-model steps from product, product-architecture, and features packs.

requirement-generator.description: Extract requirement-spec SHALL/MUST statements (role_alias=requirement-extractor; id retained for BC).

acceptance-criteria-generator.description: Extract acceptance-criteria GWT linked to requirements (role_alias=acceptance-criteria-extractor; id retained for BC).

product-knowledge-ingest.description: Extract glossary/entity/fact knowledge-notes from doc-source and discovery-report soft inputs.

feature-surface-inventory.description: Inventory feature surfaces from doc-source, app-surface, and discovery-report soft inputs.

business-rules-extractor.description: Extract observed business rules from doc-source and discovery-report soft inputs.

product-architecture-observer.description: Observe product architecture into product-architecture/ from doc-source and discovery-report. Never AIOS architecture/.

product-re-gap-report.description: Synthesize product-re-gap coverage gaps across ingest and transform outputs into gaps/.

architecture-consultant.description: Design the target solution architecture that preserves validated business capabilities. Improve modularity and recommend patterns. Produce architecture-v2 specs and ADRs. Never invent business logic.

tech-stack-consultant.description: Recommend modern technologies with alternatives and trade-offs. Produce tech-stack recommendations and migration notes. Preserve business behavior.

refactoring-consultant.description: Identify refactoring opportunities and propose migration strategy preserving validated business behavior. Reduce technical debt without changing business rules.

folder-structure-designer.description: Design feature-based repository layout and module boundaries. Produce folder conventions. Preserve business capabilities.

specification-generator.description: Transform validated project knowledge into implementation-ready software specifications with full traceability. Never invent business logic or redesign. Mark missing info as UNKNOWN.

task-generator.description: Convert validated specifications into executable engineering work items with dependencies, complexity, priority, work-item milestones, and DoD. Never invent business logic.

roadmap-generator.description: Generate release plan, phases, sprints, release milestones, risks, timeline, and delivery order. Never invent business logic or calendar dates when UNKNOWN.

implementation-planner.description: Generate implementation graph, critical path, parallel work, blocked tasks, and build order. Never invent business logic.

artifact-validator.description: Verify folder structure, required files, artifact existence, naming, output locations, and artifact contracts. Never modify artifacts.

schema-validator.description: Validate JSON Schemas, markdown structure, required fields, data types, and schema compatibility. Never modify artifacts.

dependency-validator.description: Verify worker/pipeline dependencies, detect circular and missing dependencies and invalid references. Never modify artifacts.

pipeline-validator.description: Verify execution order, stage dependencies, pipeline/worker registration, lifecycle, resume and incremental support. Never modify artifacts.

traceability-validator.description: Verify every artifact traces to features, business rules, architecture, requirements, knowledge. Reject orphans. Never modify artifacts.

completeness-validator.description: Verify missing documents, fields, modules, specifications, workers, examples, schemas. Never invent missing information — only report.

consistency-validator.description: Detect contradictions, duplications, conflicting requirements/architecture/business rules, naming inconsistencies. Never modify artifacts.

quality-scoring-engine.description: Generate structured quality scores from validation findings. Never modify source artifacts; never invent missing data.

validation-orchestrator.description: Coordinate validation order (from pipeline waves), merge findings, emit overall validation status. Never modify source artifacts.

validation-reporter.description: Generate validation summary, severity-ranked issues, recommended fixes, and PASS/FAIL decision. Machine-readable only.
